subject: Co-sell enablement: consolidated security packet for marketplace listing
messages:
From: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@amazon.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: security evidence for AWS co-sell listing

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the intro earlier. AWS Marketplace team is preparing the co-sell enablement package for Redwood and we need a consolidated security/compliance packet to attach to your listing and partner record. The reviewer asked for the following items:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent year)
- Penetration test attestation / executive summary (redacted is ok)
- Signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or indication that you accept AWS terms
- Architecture summary showing encryption at rest/in transit and KMS usage
- Evidence of vulnerability disclosure/bug bounty (if available)

Can you send a single ZIP with these artifacts by Nov 18 so we can start the internal review for co-sell qualification? Also let me know if any of the docs need redaction or have NDAs attached.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Smith
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
lauren.smith@amazon.com

--
Attachment: none

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-11T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: security evidence for AWS co-sell listing

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the checklist. We can assemble and deliver a consolidated packet by Nov 13 (earlier than your deadline) to give your reviewers time. Planned contents:

- SOC2_TypeII_Report_Redwood_2025.pdf (redacted client names)
- PenTest_Attestation_Redwood_2026.pdf (executive summary + attest letter from vendor)
- Signed_DPA_Redwood_AWS_2026.pdf (current global DPA; we'll include a one-page addendum for data residency if needed)
- Security_Architecture_Summary.pdf (KMS regions, envelope encryption, TLS details)
- KMS_Key_Management_Matrix.csv
- Short note about vulnerability disclosure program (we do private bounty via vendor; will include contact)

Question for you: does the marketplace review require a notarized pen test report, or is a vendor attestation acceptable? Also confirm if we should include GovCloud-specific artifacts for co-sell in public sector.

I'll send the ZIP and a secure link once Legal confirms a small redaction.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Request: security evidence for AWS co-sell listing

On 11/11/2026 11:05 AM, Michael Grant wrote:
> I'll send the ZIP and a secure link once Legal confirms a small redaction.

Michael — quick notes from Legal/Compliance:

- SOC2: provide the full auditor's report and a one-page cover letter that calls out any subservice organizations. We should remove customer-identifying details; redaction ok.
- Pen test: the marketplace team often accepts an attestation letter, but if they ask for an unredacted report we should coordinate an NDA with the AWS reviewer.
- DPA: our template is signed, but AWS sometimes wants a one-page addendum clarifying retention/scope for marketplace transactions — I can prepare that and route for signature (DocuSign).
- Please ask Lauren whether the review needs AWS-specific compliance checkbox answers (some reviewers want us to fill their security questionnaire). If so, we need 48-72 hours.

I'll prepare the DPA addendum and redact the SOC2 as needed. Alex — can you confirm the invite for the AWS intake form and the reviewer contact?

Kimberly Park
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

--

Let me know if your team needs us to fill an AWS security intake questionnaire (we can turn that around in 48–72 hours).

Thanks,
Michael

From: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@amazon.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.inference>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Review <marketplace-review@amazon.com>, Partner Ops <partner-ops@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement: consolidated security packet for marketplace listing

Michael —

Thanks, we received the ZIP and have assigned it to our intake team (case: AMZ-MP-2026-982). A few follow-ups:

- The packet looks good for initial review; the SOC2 redactions are acceptable at this stage.
- We do require a short pen test attestation letter signed by the testing vendor on letterhead (your PenTest_Attestation looks fine; can you confirm it includes the vendor signature page?).
- For co-sell in public sector/GovCloud we will ask for region-specific key management info (you can preemptively share KMS ARNs for us).
- Please upload the DPA addendum once signed; you can use the DocuSign link or send the PDF to marketplace-review@amazon.com.

Assuming no major issues, we expect to complete the co-sell eligibility check in ~7–10 business days. I'll flag if the reviewer needs an NDA for an unredacted SOC2.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Lauren
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
lauren.smith@amazon.com

--
